text:
It can take weeks before they see the form and schedule the actual appointment. Try to reply to the automatic email that you received when you submitted the request.

The lack of communication from their side is really the most frustrating part in this whole process. Sometimes there's no choice but to physically go to the branch at 8am when they accept people with no appointment, and wait for like an hour just to ask a question. On the bright side, you've still got time.
